newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 7.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 7.

text.p: Here are the leading headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon broadcast on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouvh for their accuracy.

- The vice-minister of the Economy Ministry, Antanas Bartulis, said on Monday that the amendments to the alcohol control law will reduce opportunities for corruption in the issuance of retail licenses.
- Klaipeda's municipality decided that private bus drivers on regular routes will have to issue tickets to the passengers.

- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis met with representatives of the Lithuanian emigre community in Chicago and stressed that Lithuania needed their political support in the country's bid for NATO membership.
